scripts.hash-password: node -e "const crypto=require('node:crypto'); const p=process.argv[1]; if(!p){console.error('Usage: npm run hash-password -- your-password'); process.exit(1)} const salt=crypto.randomBytes(16).toString('hex'); const hash=crypto.scryptSync(p,salt,64).toString('hex'); console.log('scrypt:'+salt+':'+hash)"
